exclusions.source_text: Performance status, as assessed in the ECOG grading system, ≤2
Pregnant women. (Lactating women must agree not to breast feed while taking study medications).
Patients with HIV infection if they meet either of the below criteria:
Known central nervous system or meningeal involvement by TCL
Receiving therapy for another primary malignancy (other than T-cell lymphoma).
History of chronic liver disease, veno-occlusive disease, or current alcohol abuse
Creatinine ≤1.5 × ULN OR Measured calculated creatinine clearance ≥30 mL/min for participant with creatinine levels >1.5 × institutional ULN
